points.description: States that nonlinearly transforming features lets the model learn/capture complex (non-linear) data patterns or makes non-linearly separable classes separable.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says it improves classification or helps with complex data without saying why.

points.description: States that, after the transformation, simple/basic (e.g. linear) classifiers such as SVM can classify complex datasets effectively and efficiently.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says classification becomes easier or better, without linking to simple classifiers.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying nonlinear transformation helps handle complex or non-linearly separable data and lets simple classifiers like SVM work well. Give part marks for a vague but relevant statement, such as "it makes classification easier". Give none for wrong or unrelated answers. Any wording is accepted, and technical terms are not needed.
